title: CMD Kerala Notification 2026 - Apply Online for 05 Assistant Manager, Field Engineer, Finance Manager and Other Posts
description: The Centre Management Development (CMD Kerala) has announced the latest job notification for the recruitment of 05 Assistant Manager, Field Engineer, and Finance Manager Jobs. Candidates who have completed their  B.E/ B.Tech, M.E/ M.Tech, Diploma in Civil Engineering, MBA, or any degree can use this opportunity and apply for the CMD Kerala Notification 2026 .
